plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Visual and Performing Arts, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 1404R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/visual-performing-and-liberal-arts-department/visual-and-performing-arts/visual-and-performing-arts-associate-of-arts . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Arts (page title 'Visual and Performing Arts, Associate of Arts'). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published minimum ('Total Credit Hours: 60-61'); semester tables print 15/15/15/15-16 and sum exactly at the minimum path. Variable credit: 'SCIG GE2 Any 2nd Gen. Ed. Science Course 3-4 Credits' modeled at 3 (minimum-credit path). Choice slots: 'PROG ELEC - Explore/Use/Build/Create Course' 3 cr each (student choice from the official Explore/Use/Build/Create category lists on the page); 'PROG ELEC - Program Electives' 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 credits (student choice from the official 'Program Electives List - 9 credits total': any courses from Explore, Use, Build, or Create categories not already used for the initial 12 hours, or any MUSA 100/200-level music lesson); COMM GE / MATH GE / SOCS GE / HUMA GE1 / SCIG GE / WELL GE / HUMA GE2 / SCIG GE2 / SOCS GE2 are official catalog placeholders (student choice). The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
